WITH mesh_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    m.zoneref,
    COUNT(*) as total_mesh_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (m.facetfaces::numeric / (m.facetverts * m.facetresmm * m.facetresmm)) * 1000 > 5.0 
              AND m.facetresmm < 1.0 
              AND m.geomdeltamm < 0.5 
         THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as hf_mesh_count,
    ROUND(AVG((m.facetfaces::numeric / (m.facetverts * m.facetresmm * m.facetresmm)) * 1000), 4) as avg_mcr,
    ROUND(AVG(m.facetresmm), 2) as avg_resolution_mm,
    ROUND(AVG(m.geomdeltamm), 3) as avg_geom_accuracy
  FROM scanmesh m
  GROUP BY m.zoneref
)
SELECT 
  s.zoneregistry as site_code,
  s.typesite as side_name,
  ms.total_mesh_count,
  ms.hf_mesh_count,
  ROUND(ms.hf_mesh_count::numeric / ms.total_mesh_count * 100, 2) as proportion_pct,
  ms.avg_mcr,
  ms.avg_resolution_mm,
  ms.avg_geom_accuracy,
  CASE 
    WHEN ms.hf_mesh_count >= 1 THEN 'Has High-Fidelity Meshes'
    ELSE 'Standard Mesh Quality'
  END as mesh_quality
FROM sites s
JOIN mesh_stats ms ON s.zoneregistry = ms.zoneref
ORDER BY proportion_pct DESC;
